messages:
jules: flagging weird routing after TS client v2.4.0. customers see calls routed to cost-saver model. their request payloads include quota hint header but console shows expected model.

andy: any sample headers? Id check if SDK added any new telemetry headers that the router might misinterpret.

jules: repro curl: 

````
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer KEY' \
  -H 'X-Route-Hint: premium' \
  -H 'X-Telemetry-Sample: low' \
  -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}'
````

nina: interesting. router policy had a recent change to accept telemetry hints for routing cost optimizations. if SDK started sending X-Telemetry-Sample=low, router might map that to saver pool.

frank: that sounds like a bad coupling. telemetry headers should not affect routing unless tenant opted in. is there an opt-in flag?

andy: not currently. we added a short-term heuristic to reduce cost for free-tier tenants: if telemetry sample=low and no explicit X-Route-Hint, route to saver. but this assumes only internal agents set telemetry headers. new SDK started including it by default.

jules: so SDK unintentionally triggered cost routing. churny.

ci-bot: CI job queued: revert-ts-telemetry-default -> branch build #782 at 6179999991

nina: mitigation plan: (1) patch router to require explicit tenant opt-in header for cost-routing heuristic (2) cut TS patch to stop emitting X-Telemetry-Sample by default (3) add console dashboard tile showing telemetry-hint vs routed-pool mismatches per tenant.

frank: also add telemetry flag in console and an audit log entry when telemetry-influenced routing happened.

andy: I'll own router change + metric routing.telemetry_influence_count. nina can you design dashboard widget?

nina: will do: table tenant | sent_telemetry_hint | routed_pool | events_24h. alert if >10 events/day for paid tenants.

jules: I'll cut the TS PR & release notes. we should notify support and include a short explainer for integrators.

ci-bot: Build passed: revert-ts-telemetry-default #782.

andy: deploying router fix to canary now. ci-bot: Deploy started at 6179999991.

jules: thanks all. follow-up: add integration test (sdk->gateway->router) to ensure telemetry headers don't change routing policy unless tenant opt-in. tagging @andy @nina @frank
